_meta.export_format: Simulink Model Report JSON (custom postprocess script)
_meta.system: Bilge Pump System — PumpController firmware model
_meta.description: Controller response time and failover timing data extracted from Simulink discrete-event simulation. Provides numeric bounds for controller timing constraints: nominal response, maximum tolerated delay, and failover switch time.

constraints.name: ControllerResponseTimeConstraint
constraints.description: Pump activation command must be issued within the designed response window after water level crosses triggerLevel_m. Derived from Simulink discrete-event timing analysis.

parameters.name: responseTime_s
parameters.description: Actual controller response time (sampling + processing + output latency)

parameters.name: maxResponseTime_s
parameters.description: Maximum allowed response time before safety constraint is violated

simulink_scenarios.notes: 100 ms sample interval + 900 ms processing + output latency
Background diagnostics running — tested via Simulink load injection
Watchdog reset adds ~3.9 s — marginal; hardware watchdog recommended

constraints.name: FailoverSwitchTimeConstraint
constraints.description: Time from Pump A fault detection to Pump B activation command must be within the failover window.

parameters.name: failoverTime_s
parameters.description: Time from fault detection to Pump B command issued

simulink_scenarios.notes: Detection latency if power-based health monitor only (no flow sensor)
